notes: 🗣 One language everywhere. Three flags spoke trader shorthand while the rest of the app spoke plainly — they now say what they mean: 📉 Dist? is 📉 Quiet selling?, 🏦 Inst? is 🏦 Big money?, and Accum? is Quiet buying? — on the radar, the row chips, My Rules, the report cards and all the lessons (quiz questions included). The trader terms aren't hidden: each tooltip teaches them (“traders call this distribution”), so you learn both languages. Nothing about how any flag WORKS changed — only the names now match the plain-English promise the rest of the app makes.
